acceptance_rule: Base counterexample parameter-delta error >0.02; base negative control error <=1e-7; candidate gradient and delta errors <=1e-6 on both fixtures; candidate counterexample window count [40]; every arm completes one Trainer step on both ranks with equal post-step parameters; prepared loader class is DataLoaderDispatcher.

candidate.loss_normalizer: Use num_items_in_batch/world_size for each microbatch; fallback to global_n_tokens*current_gradient_accumulation_steps if no window count is provided.
candidate.window_count: Override Trainer.get_batch_samples to sum global_n_tokens[0] from every batch in the current accumulation window.

claim_boundary: Current TRL collator, Accelerate DataLoaderDispatcher, Transformers Trainer, DDP/Gloo, and production compute_loss are executed for the two full accumulation-window fixtures. A deterministic scalar synthetic model is used; live asynchronous rollouts, finite-stream short-window behavior under DDP, vLLM, pretrained models, and downstream capabilities are outside this two-rank scope. Single-process current Trainer separately checks a shortened final window.
estimand: Compare one actual Trainer optimizer-step parameter delta after DDP gradient averaging between accumulation of microbatches and one full-batch reference with identical per-rank token rows.
primary_metrics: gradient absolute error versus full-batch reference
one-step SGD parameter delta absolute error
relationship_to_prior_work: Outcome-informed follow-up to the current-main production compute_loss and single-process Trainer reproductions. This protocol adds current Accelerate DataLoaderDispatcher and real two-process CPU DDP/Gloo. The finite-stream short-final-window fixture was excluded after it stalled before optimizer step in the dispatcher path; the single-process Trainer protocol covers that case separately.
